annotations.title: NY weekly benefit rate (TTD, TPD, reduced earnings)

description: A weekly benefit rate under the NY Workers' Compensation Law: kind "total" (temporary total: two-thirds of the AWW within the max and min for the date of accident; a wage below the minimum is paid in full), "partial" (temporary partial at a degree of disability, with the same bounds) or "reduced_earnings" (two-thirds of the wage loss, capped at the max, never raised to the min). New York State only. Computes with The Comp Desk calc-core (the engine behind the app, the website calculators and the Pro Workspace); it never estimates. If an input is missing it returns status "missing" with every input still needed and calculates nothing. Returns the figures, the rate year used, the formulas with their citations (each flagged with whether it has been attorney-reviewed), and the not-legal-advice notice.

aww.description: Average weekly wage before the injury, in dollars (gross).

current_weekly_earnings.description: kind "reduced_earnings": gross weekly earnings now, in dollars.

date_of_accident.description: Date of accident (injury), YYYY-MM-DD. Only a full date the user gave; never a guessed one.

disability_percent.description: kind "partial": degree of partial disability, 0–100 (50 means 50%).
